content.title: THOR Industries (NYSE:THO) Exceeds Q3 CY2025 Expectations
content.summary: RV manufacturer Thor Industries (NYSE:THO) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 11.5% year on year to $2.39 billion. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $9.25 billion at the midpoint came in 2.3% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.41 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
